patch_description:
Combine the inspiration’s denser-layer-first pruning with the current program’s paired cleanup after successful rewiring. This removes repeated overlap-ranking scans while preserving cohort sizing, partner sampling, failure memory, acceptance and time-93 recovery.
The hypothesis is that balanced pruning accelerates cohort construction, while paired cleanup removes remaining external links to the displaced partner. It may also destroy useful ties. Score improvement is unmeasured; evaluate the full frozen panel and inspect family-level effects and shocked/unshocked outcomes.
